request: Pull CMS Nursing Home Health Inspection Deficiencies (Provider Data) since 2025-12-01, treat each citation as a public-health-surveillance event, enrich with days_since_survey, days_to_correction, and trend analysis by state + deficiency_category. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 06 - CMS Nursing Home Surveillance' on Tableau Server for public-health analysts.

sources.name: CMS Nursing Home Health Deficiencies
sources.description: CMS Nursing Home Health Inspection Deficiencies (Provider Data API datastore r5ix-sfxw). Each row = one health-inspection citation. Filtered to survey_date > 2025-12-01 (~33K rows). Public, keyless. limit/offset pagination on the datastore endpoint.

args.name: Deficiency Trend
args.features_description: Adds row-level temporal features parsed from survey_date (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Pure pass-through of CMS deficiency citations.
args.stats_description: Long-form CMS deficiency statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over state and deficiency_category). Includes monthly_count, 30-day rolling counts, year-over-year deltas + pct change, z-score anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Use to identify states with surging citation volume or anomalous deficiency-category concentrations.

outputs.name: CMS Deficiency Detail
outputs.description: Row-level CMS Nursing Home Health Inspection deficiencies (one row per citation since 2025-12-01). Includes provider CCN, name, location, survey_date, survey_type, deficiency_category + tag_number + description, scope_severity_code (A-L), correction_date, complaint vs standard flags, infection-control flag. Plus calendar features and days_since_survey + days_to_correction. Source: CMS Provider Data API r5ix-sfxw. Refresh: monthly.

outputs.name: CMS Deficiency Stats
outputs.description: Long-form CMS deficiency statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over state and deficiency_category). Includes 30-day rolling counts, year-over-year deltas + pct change, z-score anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Source: CMS Provider Data API r5ix-sfxw.
